tasks.title: Add CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN secret so the team can run
tasks.notes: Run `claude setup-token` locally, paste the result as a repo Actions secret named CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN. Required for every team workflow.

tasks.title: Pick the Discord beat-drop channel(s) and set DISCORD_INTAKE_CHANNELS
tasks.notes: Repo variable, comma-separated channel IDs. Also add DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN secret (same bot as server/).
